audit.why: Level 1 leans Zoe (E-Q one-shot threat before Viktor's kit exists), 2-through-first-item is a dodging skill lane, two-plus items Viktor — matches packet chart and 50.07% WR.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike structure sound (bubble threat 3-5, Portal Jump angles at 6, first-item sustain flip, late outscale).

20 fields called Zoe 'he/his' (she/her per champ-gender); content mid used 'Gravity Field (E)' and 'Death Ray (W)' (real: W and Hextech Ray E); spikes[3] said 'hold E for her engage' (the hold is W); full chart rows 1 and 6 disagreed with content/packet; cooldowns had no numbers; two Do's/Don'ts bodies were tradeGood/tradeBad pastes. Sleep's doubled-wake-hit and MR shred (her E text) were nowhere on the page.
audit.why: Kit and gender files are authorities; content and packet charts agree.
audit.corrected: All pronouns fixed, slots and names fixed, sides moved with rewritten whys, cooldowns numbered (E 18s->14s, R 11/8/5s), doubled-damage fact written into dontsFull[2].d.

audit.why: Bubble's 18s rank-1 gap is the punish window; Portal Jump at 11/8/5s is nearly always up.

audit.whatIsWrong: missingInteractions also claims Zoe E cancels Viktor R as a channel and that her E cuts retreats as terrain — Viktor R's text describes no channel and Zoe E's text creates no terrain; both flags look like parse misfires.
